title: call.dial
description: Place an outbound call as this agent. The new call's log opens with call.dialing; call.started follows when the far end answers.

CallDial.description: Place an outbound call as this agent. The new call's log opens with call.dialing; call.started follows when the far end answers.

from.description: The number to show, E.164. Absent means the agent's first phone route.

metadata.description: Anything the app wants handed to the session at start, sealed by the platform, never seen by the far end.
